verdict.rationale: Gusto's platform overview lists "Generate payroll reports" as a capability, and the API supports pagination for large result sets, but there is no documented detail on payroll register format, gross-to-net breakdown, or specific export mechanisms (CSV/Excel) for ops analysis. missing for 10: dedicated payroll register/gross-to-net report endpoints, export format documentation (CSV/Excel/PDF), and independent confirmation of report usability for ops teams.
